title: That Label's Got Style: Handling Label Style Bias for Uncertain Image Segmentation
mechanism: Condition stochastic segmentation models (Probabilistic U-Net, SSN) on a discrete label-style variable, modelling p(annotation | image, style) instead of p(annotation | image), which removes style-induced area bias.
adaptation: Style = source. Cheapest form is a one-hot source code into the decoder (shares the arm of the CIN paper); the stochastic variant adds per-source crack sample distributions for calibrated uncertainty and severity flags. Use as small-data evidence and as the probabilistic follow-up.
min_experiment: Arm: c-SSN crack head conditioned on source on house PF, 5 seeds vs house PF; metric clean-49 crack IoU (mean prediction) and crack ECE; kill if IoU gain < +0.012 and ECE not reduced by >= 20%.
evidence: R: ISIC subset, 179 train image-mask pairs over 3 styles; c-Prob.U-Net IoU 0.77/0.78/0.76 vs pooled 0.65/0.65/0.69; PhC-U373 0.92 vs 0.89-0.90. Small data, blob objects.
